clarity.justification: Messages were unambiguous and well-structured, with agents clearly stating their current locations, inventories, and intentions.

planning_coherence.justification: Agents understood task dependencies well, correctly identifying the need to cut ingredients before assembly and requesting peers to drop required items at the assembly station.

failure_explanation_quality.justification: Agents consistently and clearly explained why actions failed (e.g., missing ingredients, resource locks) and immediately proposed actionable recovery steps.
